name: pi-pocket-agent-civilization

author: Tanner Middleton

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node --check agent-civilization/index.js && node --check agent-civilization/town.js && node --check agent-civilization/pixels.js && node --check agent-civilization/demo.js && node --check agent-civilization/sound.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --tab-width 4 --print-width 100 agent-civilization.ts agent-civilization/*.js agent-civilization/style.css test/*.ts README.md package.json
